issue_context.title: allow easier user customizable `decay_parameters` in trainer
issue_context.body:
### Feature request

allow easier user customizable `decay_parameters` in trainer

### Motivation

https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/32ec7345f2d752c294ddf5aff495b657c9cd9d3b/src/transformers/trainer.py#L964-L965

Currently to modify `decay_parameters` for weight decay, user need to inherit and implement the entire `create_optimizer`. By refactor this two line into a function, user can modify `decay_parameters` much easier.

### Your contribution

if this sounds good, i am happy to submit a PR
comments: cc @muellerzr if you think this should be done?
This *feels* like it's okay to me, but I'd need to see what the full implementation will look like @shijie-wu if you want to take a stab at it :)

review_comments: this could be easily overlooked and i am not sure what the best solution is. i could see that we (1) add all variants of layernorm - which introduce one more thing to maintain for future models; or (2) log it to make it more visible - which might again be overlooked; or (3) just document this in the docstring
I think this is okay, the `ALL_LAYERNORM_LAYERS` should contain all the custom layer norm classes (from `transformers` modeling files) and should be updated if that is not the case

TIL each `modeling_*.py` is supposed to add their custom LayerNorm to `ALL_LAYERNORM_LAYERS`. Notably LLaMa (among [others models](https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Ahuggingface%2Ftransformers+%2F%5Cw%2BLayerNorm%2F+path%3A%2F%5Esrc%5C%2Ftransformers%5C%2Fmodels%5C%2F%2F&type=code)) didn't add `LlamaRMSNorm` to `ALL_LAYERNORM_LAYERS`, and only a small portion of models has [this logic](https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Ahuggingface%2Ftransformers+%2FALL_LAYERNORM_LAYERS.append%5C%28%5Cw%2BLayerNorm%5C%29%2F+path%3A%2F%5Esrc%5C%2Ftransformers%5C%2Fmodels%5C%2F%2F&type=code)
